title: Recover a landmark-oriented oblique CT section pose
question: Single-slice localization requires discovering the correct six-degree-of-freedom alignment before local intensity refinement; partial field of view may reduce recognizable context.
prior_findings: Not established: both frozen same-acquisition full and partial views passed Terra/high normally. RMS physical errors were 0.000477 and 0.000586 mm versus a 3 mm tolerance. A public-input-only author baseline also solves both in seconds.
next_action: Retire the tested snapshots. Preserve evidence; do not infer anatomical understanding or cross-acquisition ability from exact-texture matching. Paired-scan or modality successors need independent correspondence truth and an adequate transform model before admission.
